title: BPSC Stenographer Answer Key 2026
vacancyDetails: Answer key related update for Stenographer Examination – Answer Key
selectionProcess: Written / CBT → Answer Key / Objections → Result
documentsRequired: Registration number / roll number; admit card for reference
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.bpsc.bih.nic.in
2. Open Answer Key / Response Sheet section
3. Download BPSC Stenographer Answer Key 2026
4. Match answers with your response sheet
5. Raise objections within the official window if allowed
shortDescription: BPSC Stenographer Answer Key 2026 out. Download from bpsc.bih.nic.in.
content:
BPSC has released the Stenographer Answer Key 2026 (provisional / as published stage).

Candidates can download the key from the official BPSC website and follow the objection process if announced separately from the final key.
